issues.summary: Use the decorator form instead of a context manager/explicit call in the doc example to save an indentation level.
The doc example's hook does something trivial; use a more meaningful example, such as using the profiler API to add a custom range around the optimizer step.

The way Muon is exposed in torch/optim/__init__.py doesn't match how other optimizers are exposed; the reviewer weakly prefers a new public torch.optim.muon module that re-exports the contents of _muon.
If this change fixes the public API binding error, the matching allowlist entry should also be removed, but it wasn't.
